trap.label: despite + oração
trap.wrong: Despite it was late, she called.
trap.right: Although it was late, she called.
trap.why: Em português "apesar de que" aceita oração. Em inglês despite + substantivo/-ing; com oração use although.

opts: Although it rained, but we left.
Although of the rain, we left.

mcq.q: Complete: **___** the traffic, he arrived early.

opts: Tom is tall, whereas Ben is short.
Tom is tall despite Ben is short.
Tom is tall although of Ben.
In spite the cost, we bought it.
In spite of it was costly, we bought it.
In spite of the cost, we bought it.

fix.wrong: Despite of the cold, we swam.
Although he was rich, but he was sad.
fix.right: Although he was rich, he was sad.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com even though: “Although he was ill, he came.”
rewrite.answer: Even though he was ill, he came.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com despite -ing: “Although she was tired, she ran.”
Una com although: “It was late. We kept working.”
rewrite.answer: Although it was late, we kept working.
